title: dasiphora glabra
intro: Dasiphora glabra, commonly known as Eurasian burnet, is a flowering plant in the rose family that is native to China and other parts of Asia. The health benefits of Dasiphora glabra include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to relax the body and mind, reducing anxiety and stress, which can be achieved through its sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Dasiphora glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
